detail.longDescription: Hello! I'm the solo founder/builder of FN2 AI and I built a free set of skills that you can use with an API key to dispatch research agents to search earnings calls, SEC filings, economic data, financial news, and more without having to set up all those sources yourself. These agents can be invoked directly in a CC session, or scheduled at a certain time or to coincide with certain market events (Price Movements, Market Open, etc.), and it runs on self hosted infrastructure/k8s/custom stack that I maintain myself in two regions. I lean heavily into OSS models, and had a lot of fun building this. I can talk at depth about things that have been working or not working if anyone is interested. Thanks!
